why:why.q.b.reason: Repeated rationale and cleanup example are demonstrated by the homepage; distinct vision, ambition and goal remain under the comparison.
why:why.q.b.sourceText: Every day you have countless ideas to convey: emails, messages, notes, documents. But you choose the slowest way — typing one character at a time.

why:why.t.h.reason: Repeated rationale and cleanup example are demonstrated by the homepage; distinct vision, ambition and goal remain under the comparison.
why:why.t.h.sourceText: All you really need is to get your ideas out.

why:why.t.b1.reason: Repeated rationale and cleanup example are demonstrated by the homepage; distinct vision, ambition and goal remain under the comparison.
why:why.t.b1.sourceText: Your input method should keep up with your brain, not slow it down. When you already have a complete thought, why spend a minute typing it out?

why:why.t.b2.reason: Repeated rationale and cleanup example are demonstrated by the homepage; distinct vision, ambition and goal remain under the comparison.
why:why.t.b2.sourceText: Your mouth is much faster than your fingers. From thought to speech, there's almost no delay. Speaking is the most natural, most efficient form of human output — but past voice input was too rough: inaccurate recognition, filler words everywhere, messy formatting.
